{"basis": "The chart displays a direct conflict between the visual bar heights and the printed percentage labels. Based on the visual geometry (record r1), the Safari bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 63 on the y-axis, which is higher than the Edge bar (~46) and the Chrome bar (~53). However, the printed percentage labels (record r2) indicate Edge is the highest at 44%, followed by Chrome at 38%, with Safari labeled as only 4%. Because the visual data and the label data are in direct and irreconcilable conflict regarding which browser has the highest market share, there is no single supported option."
, "option_label": null}
